sample_unit: evaluators (119 women, 29 clinicians) rating chatbot responses
models_evaluated: DIAN (RAG pregnancy chatbot grounded in NHS Pregnancy Book)

links.outcome: Women's vs clinicians' Likert ratings of comprehensibility, accuracy, readability of chatbot responses
links.effect: Differences concentrated in postpartum care: comprehensibility favored women (p=0.012), accuracy favored women (p=0.018), readability favored clinicians (p=0.008); other domains showed no significant differences after correction.
links.quote: Other domains showed no significant between-group differences after correction.

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation grounded in an authoritative national guide (NHS Pregnancy Book) to improve output fidelity

screen.reason: Evaluates a RAG-based pregnancy chatbot (DIAN) by having patients and clinicians rate standardized responses for comprehensibility, accuracy, and readability, but does not compare against a non-RAG baseline or test a specific deployment safeguard/practice.
